m: यभ् cl. 1. P. (Dhātup. xxiii, 11) यभति (or Ā. ˚ते, Vet.; pf. ययाभ Gr.; aor. अयाप्सीत्, ib.; fut. यप्स्यति, TBr.; inf. यभितुम्, BhP., यब्धुम्, TBr., Sch.), to have sexual intercourse, futuere, AV. &c. &c.: Desid. यियप्सति, ˚ते, to desire sexual intercourse, ŚrS.
a: यभ् — {c1c} P. (यभति) To cohabit, have sexual intercourse with.

s: O mETune । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (BvA॰para॰-aka॰-aniw .) O, ayApsIt । yaBati yuvA । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
v: mETune BvA॰ para॰ saka॰ aniw । yamati ayA(ya)sIt ।

m: यभन n. copulation, sexual intercourse, Vop.
यभ्या f. to be carnally known (see अ- and सुयभ्या).
